title: Extended Interview: President Trump on 60 Minutes
description:
President Trump sat down with Ross Douthat in November 2026 to discuss Republican losses in the midterm elections, the wars in Iran and Ukraine, the economy, and more.

00:00 Midterm election
07:36 Gas prices, Iran
11:37 Israel
13:58 Immigration
19:41 AI
26:04 Firing staffers
29:40 Succession
31:19 Wealth and foreign influence
37:36 UFOs
40:33 Russia-Ukraine War
45:46 His legacy
